# InboxZap

> InboxZap is an email cleanup app that bulk-deletes old email, mass-unsubscribes
> from newsletters, and automatically sorts incoming mail for Gmail and Outlook.
> Free for personal inboxes.

## Product

- [Features](https://lumina.example/features): Bulk delete, mass unsubscribe, automatic sorting.
- [Pricing](https://lumina.example/pricing): Free personal tier, Pro, and Team plans.
